channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Dairy Queen: Free Mini Blizzard Treat with Any $1+ App Order
item.guid: Dairy Queen-Free Mini Blizzard Treat with Any $1+ Ap-2026-07-27
item.description: Download or open the DQ app, place any order of $1 or more, and a free mini Blizzard Treat is added automatically — today is the last day. (Through July 27, 2026)

item.title: Dairy Queen: $7 Meal Deal — 4 Items Including a Sundae
item.guid: Dairy Queen-$7 Meal Deal — 4 Items Including a Sunda-2026-07-27
item.description: Get three crispy chicken strips or an original cheeseburger, regular fries, a 21 oz drink, dipping sauce, and a sundae for $7 in store, online, or in app. (Limited time)

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Classic Frosty
item.description: Get a small Classic Frosty for just $1 at the counter, drive-thru, or in the Wendy's app at participating locations nationwide — no promo code needed. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu — Chicken, Sides, or Sandwich
item.guid: Popeyes-$5 Faves Menu — Chicken, Sides, or Sandw-2026-07-27
item.description: Choose from three pieces of chicken, two sides, or a chicken sandwich from the $5 Faves Menu at participating Popeyes locations. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Burger King: $5 Your Way Meal — Daily Value Bundle
item.guid: Burger King-$5 Your Way Meal — Daily Value Bundle-2026-07-27
item.description: Pick a sandwich, 4-piece nuggets, small fries, and a small drink for $5 through the BK app at participating locations every day. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: $5 Value Meal Box — McDouble or McChicken Bundle
item.guid: McDonald's-$5 Value Meal Box — McDouble or McChicke-2026-07-27
item.description: App deal includes your choice of McDouble or McChicken, 4-piece McNuggets, small fries, and a small drink for $5 at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME-2026-07-27
item.description: Use code CUSTARDTIME at an in-restaurant kiosk, the Shake Shack app, or website to get any custard for just $3 at participating locations. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Panera Bread: Buy One Entree, Get a Second for $5
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy One Entree, Get a Second for $5-2026-07-27
item.description: Use a Panera promo code in the app or online to add a second entree to your order for only $5 — soups, sandwiches, and salads qualify at participating locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Subway: $6.99 Footlong with Code 699FORFTL
item.description: Enter code 699FORFTL in the Subway app or online at checkout to get any footlong sub for $6.99 at participating locations; availability may vary by zip code. (Limited time)

item.title: The Habit Burger Grill: $5 Gotta Habit Grilled Chicken Wraps
item.guid: The Habit Burger Grill-$5 Gotta Habit Grilled Chicken Wraps-2026-07-27
item.description: Choose from the Avocado Ranch Chicken, Chicken Caesar, or BBQ Chicken Wrap for just $5 each — a lighter, high-protein drive-thru option for a limited time. (Limited time)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving the delivery fee on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed, open to everyone. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
